dogecoin.text: @CryptoDOMEhats I first got in at $.09. It took me that long to figure out how to even buy it! Besides screwing around with dogecoin on my now deactivated Robinhood account, it's the first and only crypto I've owned. I should've bought way more, obviously.
@redditinvestors There will never be another dogecoin. Can you rephrase the question?

I'm taking a course at the local college. Literally every day my fellow (younger) students talk about #dogecoin and the price. They think they're early and getting in at the ground level, with a couple hundred $ of #doge, at ~$25. Scale this globally, and you see the end is near.
